_note: Frozen before training (plan section 15). 'pretrain': pagoda's 3 completion prompts, sampled greedily during pretraining (prefix BOS, tok.encode). 'chat': one conversation per thinking mode (think = /think switch, no_think = /no_think switch, prefilled = enable_thinking false; tool = non-thinking with tools=chat.TOOLS), for samples during post-training; each entry can be passed to engine.chat_batch as an item (tools true = chat.TOOLS). 'mode_switch_eval': the 34 base prompts of the mode-switch eval (bonsai.tasks.evals, 100 items cycling think / no_think / prefilled), the reported number only. 'mode_switch_dev': 34 other prompts in the same style (none in mode_switch_eval or the prompt pools) for gating checkpoints (the on-policy format check, eval_mode_switch(split='dev')), so model selection never sees the reported set.
